chunks.text: Data Hub: Choose the suitable bundle, share it with your employees and support them with the speed of 4G. Bundles: - WE Business Data Hub 18: Monthly Fees 650 EGP, Quota 18 GB, Sim Card Included 6. - WE Business Data Hub 35: Monthly Fees 1250 EGP, Quota 35 GB, Sim Card Included 12. - WE Business Data Hub 80: Monthly Fees 2800 EGP, Quota 80 GB, Sim Card Included 30. - WE Business Data Hub 160: Monthly Fees 5300 EGP, Quota 160 GB, Sim Card Included 60. - WE Business Data Hub 320: Monthly Fees 9500 EGP, Quota 320 GB, Sim Card Included 120.
Terms & Conditions: - Out of bundle rate is 10 PTS per MB. - Add extra SIM Card to your group for 8 EGP monthly.
